attr.title: Residual
attr.desc: Explore alien planets, gather resources and repair your ship in a procedurally generated survival platformer.
attr.inst: Install Residual.zip, then copy your owned residual.jar into the installed residual folder. See residual.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
